prior_first_result_seen: In PR251 naive pooled heterogeneous Bernoulli reference incorrectly assumed Binomial, and confounded null showed 27.5%,90%,99% naive detection vs 0% corrected. Here distinguish valid reference-binomial sampling from q transport.
identifiability_question: Can an IID correctly calibrated camera reference population still fail when applied to a biologically different target distance-mixture even with infinite reference sample size?
inherited_exact_same_source_free_truths: Four distance/season/solar-phase worlds, q_near=.9, q_far=.3, reference near fraction=.5, target mix [.5]*4, [.2,.8,.8,.2], [.8,.2,.2,.8], alternative latent OR2 + [.2,.8,.8,.2]. Reuse parent physical-site fixed-margin animal data and corrected 8 q+4 mix receipts with exactly same original RNG for each replicate.

comparator_reference.physical_sampling: Independently labeled reference opportunities: for each of four phase×season cells, each opportunity independently chooses near distance Bernoulli(0.5), then independently hits focal camera with q_near=.9 or q_far=.3. Marginal detector outcome for each reference opportunity is IID Bernoulli(0.6), thus total successes genuinely Binomial(2n,0.6) per cell.
comparator_reference.random_reference_sample: 2n valid independent iid 50/50-mixture reference opportunities per season×solar-bin, n in original 50,200,1000; this equals 8n total reference q opportunities across 4 cells
comparator_reference.random_seed_extra_reference: SeedSequence([2026100916,world_index,n_index,replicate_index,734]) independent from prior complete old reference/wildlife draws
comparator_reference.reference_interval: Four-cell simultaneous Clopper-Pearson two-sided CP alpha_q=.025 (0.025/8 in each one-sided tail); correct finite-sample simultaneous coverage >=.975 for the REFERENCE q=.6 across all four bins, not target q when mix differs.
comparator_reference.animal_exact_test: Fisher noncentral upper tail at known camera effort OR1 times q-reference interaction upper bound, animal alpha=.025; no target-mixture correction; invalid ecological transport for shifted target mix even though reference q CP mathematically valid.

corrected_target_calibration: Reuse v0 8 separate distance q plus 4 independently measured target mix CP bands, animal alpha=.025, total .0125+.0125+.025=.05. Keep same animal observations and original target-calibrated results, assert replay.

claims: For an IID reference distribution, Clopper-Pearson can be exact and still be irrelevant to a target wildlife opportunity distribution. This is model transport/standardization, not a new Clopper-Pearson theorem nor observed animal ecology.
